title: Pilot account asks - consolidated, with contacts
raw_text:
From: Dana (Customer Success) <dana.osei@neuronforge.com>
To: Marcus (Head of Product) <marcus.bell@neuronforge.com>, Priya (Eng Lead) <priya.raghavan@neuronforge.com>
Subject: Pilot account asks — consolidated, with contacts
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12

Marcus, Priya,

Consolidated list from this week's three calls. I have left the contact details in because you will both need them for the follow-ups, and because Tom keeps asking me for them on Slack.

1. Northwind Logistics — Rachel Okonkwo, Head of Operations (rachel.okonkwo@northwindlogistics.com, +44 20 7946 0812). Rachel's team runs eleven depots and she says the national view is useless to a depot manager. Her ask: a user must be able to filter any dashboard to a single depot and have every chart on that dashboard follow the filter. She was very clear it has to be every chart, not chart by chart. She is on holiday from 8 Sept, so if you want her in a call it is this week or the 20th.

2. Meridian Bank — Daniel Vetrov, IT Security (d.vetrov@meridianbank.example, direct line +44 161 496 0033, mobile 07700 900412). Daniel will not sign the pilot agreement until this is written down: ForgeSight must be reachable only from the customer's allow-listed IP ranges, with everything else refused at the edge. He used the phrase "no open internet surface". He also asked, twice, whether we could send the answer to his personal address (dan.vetrov88@fastmail.example) because he is travelling. I said no.

3. Halcyon Retail Group — Sofia Marchetti, Programme Lead (sofia.marchetti@halcyonretail.eu, +39 335 774 2210). Two things. First, an admin must be able to set the account's default time zone, and every timestamp in ForgeSight must display in that time zone. Their ops team is in Milan and half our timestamps are showing UTC, which has already caused one argument about a stockout that happened "at midnight". Second, currency: the display currency has to be configurable per account, because euros shown with a pound sign is not a cosmetic problem for a retailer.

Sofia's assistant is Luca Bianchi (l.bianchi@halcyonretail.eu, +39 02 8088 1140) and he is the one who actually books the meetings.

I have not put any of this in the tracker yet. Tell me which of the four you want in the pilot and I will write them up properly.

Dana
